```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(aqp)

# Source the SHARED pedon-pack module (used by both NCSS and Perry).
source("../code/pedon_pack_functions_05_02_2026.R")
```

```{r load-raw}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load raw NCSS tables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ncss_pedon         <- read.csv("../data/ncss_pedon_SCP.csv")
ncss_phorizon      <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phorizon.csv")
ncss_color         <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phcolor.csv")
ncss_mottles       <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phmottles.csv")
ncss_ped_taxa      <- read.csv("../data/petaxhistory.csv")
ncss_pedonlabdata  <- read.csv("../data/ncss_pedonlabdata.csv")
ncss_layerlabdata  <- read.csv("../data/ncss_layerlabdata.csv")
ncss_phsample      <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phsample.csv")
```

```{r merge-taxonomy}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build pedon-level taxonomy table (one row per peiid)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ncss_pedon <- ncss_pedon %>%
  select(siteobsiidref, upedonid, taxonname, taxclname, taxonkind,
         pedontype, pedbiidref, grpiidref, peiid, POINT_X, POINT_Y)

ncss_ped_taxa <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  select(peiidref, taxonname, taxonkind, seriesstatus, taxclname, taxorder,
         taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize, taxpartsizemod,
         taxceactcl, taxreaction, taxtempcl, taxmoistscl, taxtempregime,
         petaxhistoryiid)

# Pick best (most complete, most recent) taxonomy row per pedon
taxa_best <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(str_trim(.x), "")),
    filled = rowSums(!is.na(across(c(
      taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize, taxclname, taxonname
    ))))
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  arrange(desc(filled), desc(petaxhistoryiid)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

pedon_taxa <- ncss_pedon %>%
  left_join(
    taxa_best %>%
      select(peiidref, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize),
    by = c("peiid" = "peiidref")
  )
```

```{r normalize-fill-taxonomy}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize blanks, build series key, and fill taxonomy from series-level lookup
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

pedon_taxa2 <- pedon_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    taxonname = na_if(str_squish(taxonname), ""),
    taxclname = na_if(str_squish(taxclname), ""),
    taxclname = ifelse(taxclname == "Not Classified", NA_character_, taxclname),
    across(c(taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize),
           ~ na_if(str_squish(.x), "")),
    taxonname_key   = toupper(taxonname),
    taxonname_clean = str_to_title(taxonname_key)
  )

# Series-level lookup INSIDE the coastal plain table
series_tax_lookup <- pedon_taxa2 %>%
  group_by(taxonname_key) %>%
  summarise(
    taxorder    = first(na.omit(taxorder)),
    taxsuborder = first(na.omit(taxsuborder)),
    taxgrtgroup = first(na.omit(taxgrtgroup)),
    taxsubgrp   = first(na.omit(taxsubgrp)),
    taxpartsize = first(na.omit(taxpartsize)),
    taxclname   = first(na.omit(taxclname)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pedon_taxa_filled <- pedon_taxa2 %>%
  left_join(series_tax_lookup, by = "taxonname_key", suffix = c("", "_series")) %>%
  mutate(
    taxorder    = coalesce(taxorder,    taxorder_series),
    taxsuborder = coalesce(taxsuborder, taxsuborder_series),
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, taxgrtgroup_series),
    taxsubgrp   = coalesce(taxsubgrp,   taxsubgrp_series),
    taxpartsize = coalesce(taxpartsize, taxpartsize_series),
    taxclname   = coalesce(taxclname,   taxclname_series)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_series"))

# GLOBAL (whole-history) series lookup, then fill again
taxa_series_lookup <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    taxonname     = na_if(str_squish(taxonname), ""),
    taxonname_key = toupper(taxonname),
    across(c(taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize),
           ~ na_if(str_squish(.x), ""))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxonname_key)) %>%
  group_by(taxonname_key) %>%
  summarise(
    taxclname   = first(na.omit(taxclname)),
    taxorder    = first(na.omit(taxorder)),
    taxsuborder = first(na.omit(taxsuborder)),
    taxgrtgroup = first(na.omit(taxgrtgroup)),
    taxsubgrp   = first(na.omit(taxsubgrp)),
    taxpartsize = first(na.omit(taxpartsize)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pedon_taxa_globalfilled <- pedon_taxa_filled %>%
  left_join(taxa_series_lookup, by = "taxonname_key", suffix = c("", "_global")) %>%
  mutate(
    taxclname   = coalesce(taxclname,   taxclname_global),
    taxorder    = coalesce(taxorder,    taxorder_global),
    taxsuborder = coalesce(taxsuborder, taxsuborder_global),
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, taxgrtgroup_global),
    taxsubgrp   = coalesce(taxsubgrp,   taxsubgrp_global),
    taxpartsize = coalesce(taxpartsize, taxpartsize_global)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_global")) %>%
  mutate(
    taxclname = ifelse(
      !is.na(taxclname),
      str_replace(str_squish(taxclname), "\\.+$", ""),
      taxclname
    )
  )
```

```{r derive-missing-ranks}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derive missing taxonomic ranks from taxclname suffixes when needed
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

gg_to_suborder <- function(gg) {
  gg0 <- str_replace_all(tolower(str_squish(gg)), "[^a-z]", "")
  case_when(
    str_detect(gg0, "udults$")   ~ "Udults",
    str_detect(gg0, "ustults$")  ~ "Ustults",
    str_detect(gg0, "xerults$")  ~ "Xerults",
    str_detect(gg0, "torults$")  ~ "Torults",
    str_detect(gg0, "aquults$")  ~ "Aquults",
    str_detect(gg0, "humults$")  ~ "Humults",
    str_detect(gg0, "paleudults$") ~ "Udults",
    str_detect(gg0, "paleults$") ~ "Udults",
    str_detect(gg0, "udalfs$")   ~ "Udalfs",
    str_detect(gg0, "ustalfs$")  ~ "Ustalfs",
    str_detect(gg0, "xeralfs$")  ~ "Xeralfs",
    str_detect(gg0, "aqualfs$")  ~ "Aqualfs",
    str_detect(gg0, "udepts$")   ~ "Udepts",
    str_detect(gg0, "ustepts$")  ~ "Ustepts",
    str_detect(gg0, "xerepts$")  ~ "Xerepts",
    str_detect(gg0, "aquepts$")  ~ "Aquepts",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

suborder_to_order <- function(so) {
  so0 <- str_replace_all(tolower(str_squish(so)), "[^a-z]", "")
  case_when(
    str_detect(so0, "ults$") ~ "Ultisols",
    str_detect(so0, "alfs$") ~ "Alfisols",
    str_detect(so0, "epts$") ~ "Inceptisols",
    str_detect(so0, "ents$") ~ "Entisols",
    str_detect(so0, "olls$") ~ "Mollisols",
    str_detect(so0, "ods$")  ~ "Spodosols",
    str_detect(so0, "ists$") ~ "Histosols",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

pedon_taxa_fixed <- pedon_taxa_globalfilled %>%
  transmute(
    siteobsiidref, upedonid, peiid,
    taxonname, taxonname_key, taxonname_clean,
    taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize,
    POINT_X, POINT_Y
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxclname = na_if(str_squish(taxclname), ""),
    taxclname = ifelse(!is.na(taxclname), str_replace(taxclname, "\\.+$", ""), taxclname),

    subgrp_from_taxcl = ifelse(
      (is.na(taxsubgrp) | is.na(taxgrtgroup) | is.na(taxsuborder) | is.na(taxorder)) & !is.na(taxclname),
      str_trim(str_extract(taxclname, "^[^,]+")),
      NA_character_
    ),
    gg_from_taxcl       = ifelse(!is.na(subgrp_from_taxcl), word(subgrp_from_taxcl, -1), NA_character_),
    suborder_from_taxcl = ifelse(is.na(taxsuborder) & !is.na(gg_from_taxcl),
                                 gg_to_suborder(gg_from_taxcl), NA_character_),
    order_from_taxcl    = ifelse(is.na(taxorder)    & !is.na(suborder_from_taxcl),
                                 suborder_to_order(suborder_from_taxcl), NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxsubgrp   = coalesce(taxsubgrp,   subgrp_from_taxcl),
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, gg_from_taxcl),
    taxsuborder = coalesce(taxsuborder, suborder_from_taxcl),
    taxorder    = coalesce(taxorder,    order_from_taxcl)
  ) %>%
  select(-subgrp_from_taxcl, -gg_from_taxcl, -suborder_from_taxcl, -order_from_taxcl) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(taxonname, "SND"), !str_detect(taxonname, "Snd"))
```

```{r parse-subgroup}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parse taxsubgrp into modifier slots: taxsubgrp_mod1/2/3
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

parse_subgrp_mods <- function(subgrp, gg_hint = NA_character_) {
  x0 <- subgrp %>% as.character() %>% str_squish() %>% na_if("")
  if (is.na(x0)) {
    return(tibble(
      subgrp_gg = gg_hint %||% NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod1 = NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod2 = NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod3 = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  toks <- str_split(x0, "\\s+", simplify = FALSE)[[1]]
  toks <- toks[toks != ""]
  if (length(toks) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      subgrp_gg = gg_hint %||% NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod1 = NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod2 = NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod3 = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  gg   <- if (!is.na(gg_hint) && str_squish(gg_hint) != "") gg_hint else toks[length(toks)]
  mods <- if (length(toks) >= 2) toks[1:(length(toks) - 1)] else character(0)

  tibble(
    subgrp_gg      = gg,
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = mods[1] %||% NA_character_,
    taxsubgrp_mod2 = mods[2] %||% NA_character_,
    taxsubgrp_mod3 = mods[3] %||% NA_character_
  )
}

pedon_taxa_parsed <- pedon_taxa_fixed %>%
  mutate(parsed = map2(taxsubgrp, taxgrtgroup, parse_subgrp_mods)) %>%
  unnest_wider(parsed) %>%
  mutate(taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, subgrp_gg)) %>%
  select(-subgrp_gg)
```

```{r build-horizon-table}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build NCSS horizon-level table: lab data + horizon depths + color
# This is the table that, after a few derivations, will conform to
# PEDON_PACK_HZ_SCHEMA.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Lab rows joined to phiid (via phsample)
layerlab_with_peiid <- ncss_layerlabdata %>%
  left_join(ncss_phsample %>% select(labsampnum, phiidref), by = "labsampnum") %>%
  select(phiidref, labsampnum, layerseqnum, hzdept, hzdepb, hzname, texcl,
         ncsslayerlabdataiid, sandtotmeasured, silttotmeasured,
         claytotmeasured, cec7)

# 2) Add pedon id (peiid) via phorizon
layerlab_with_pedid <- layerlab_with_peiid %>%
  left_join(ncss_phorizon %>% select(phiid, peiidref), by = c("phiidref" = "phiid")) %>%
  rename(peiid = peiidref)

# 3) Pick best matrix color per horizon (moist/interior preferred)
color_best <- ncss_color %>%
  mutate(
    moist_rank = case_when(
      str_to_lower(colormoistst) == "moist" ~ 1L,
      str_to_lower(colormoistst) == "dry"   ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ 3L
    ),
    phys_rank = case_when(
      str_to_lower(colorphysst) == "interior" ~ 1L,
      str_to_lower(colorphysst) == "exterior" ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ 3L
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(phiidref, moist_rank, phys_rank) %>%
  group_by(phiidref) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(phiidref, colorhue, colorvalue, colorchroma)

ncss_hz_raw <- layerlab_with_pedid %>%
  left_join(color_best, by = "phiidref")
```

```{r parse-hzname}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parse horizon designations into master / suffix / hz_base / hzname_clean.
# Uses the SHARED parser (parse_hznames) defined in pedon_pack_functions.R
# so NCSS and Perry produce identical hz_base label sets.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ncss_hz_parsed <- ncss_hz_raw %>%
  bind_cols(
    parse_hznames(.$hzname) %>% select(hzname_clean, L_master, L_suffix, hz_base)
  )
```

```{r color-rgb}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert Munsell color -> R, G, B in [0, 1]
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ncss_hz_color <- ncss_hz_parsed %>%
  mutate(
    munsell = if_else(
      !is.na(colorhue) & !is.na(colorvalue) & !is.na(colorchroma),
      paste0(str_squish(colorhue), " ", colorvalue, "/", colorchroma),
      NA_character_
    ),
    munsell_hex = aqp::parseMunsell(munsell)
  )

idx <- which(!is.na(ncss_hz_color$munsell_hex) & ncss_hz_color$munsell_hex != "")
rgb_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(ncss_hz_color), 3,
                  dimnames = list(NULL, c("R","G","B")))
rgb_mat[idx, ] <- t(grDevices::col2rgb(ncss_hz_color$munsell_hex[idx])) / 255

ncss_hz_color <- ncss_hz_color %>%
  mutate(R = rgb_mat[, "R"], G = rgb_mat[, "G"], B = rgb_mat[, "B"])
```

```{r assemble-schema}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assemble the two tables that build_pedon_pack() needs:
#
#   (a) ncss_hz_table  -- horizon-level, conforms to PEDON_PACK_HZ_SCHEMA
#   (b) ncss_ped_table -- pedon-level taxonomy, conforms to PEDON_PACK_PED_SCHEMA
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ncss_hz_table <- ncss_hz_color %>%
  transmute(
    peiid           = as.character(peiid),
    hzdept          = as.numeric(hzdept),
    hzdepb          = as.numeric(hzdepb),
    hzname          = as.character(hzname),
    hzname_clean    = as.character(hzname_clean),
    hz_base         = as.character(hz_base),
    L_master        = as.character(L_master),
    L_suffix        = as.character(L_suffix),
    texcl           = as.character(texcl),
    sandtotmeasured = as.numeric(sandtotmeasured),
    silttotmeasured = as.numeric(silttotmeasured),
    claytotmeasured = as.numeric(claytotmeasured),
    cec7            = as.numeric(cec7),
    R               = as.numeric(R),
    G               = as.numeric(G),
    B               = as.numeric(B)
  )

ncss_ped_table <- pedon_taxa_parsed %>%
  transmute(
    peiid           = as.character(peiid),
    taxonname_clean = as.character(taxonname_clean),
    taxorder        = as.character(taxorder),
    taxsuborder     = as.character(taxsuborder),
    taxgrtgroup     = as.character(taxgrtgroup),
    taxsubgrp_mod1  = as.character(taxsubgrp_mod1),
    taxsubgrp_mod2  = as.character(taxsubgrp_mod2),
    taxsubgrp_mod3  = as.character(taxsubgrp_mod3),
    taxpartsize     = as.character(taxpartsize),
    POINT_X         = as.numeric(POINT_X),
    POINT_Y         = as.numeric(POINT_Y)
  )

# Restrict horizon table to pedons present in the taxonomy table (and vice versa)
ncss_hz_table  <- ncss_hz_table  %>% filter(peiid %in% ncss_ped_table$peiid)
ncss_ped_table <- ncss_ped_table %>% filter(peiid %in% ncss_hz_table$peiid |
                                            peiid %in% ncss_hz_table$peiid)

# Validate against the contract before passing in
validate_hz_schema(ncss_hz_table,   source_name = "NCSS horizon table")
validate_ped_schema(ncss_ped_table, source_name = "NCSS pedon table")
```

```{r build-pedon-pack}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the NCSS pedon_pack_150 using the SHARED builder.
# Perry will call build_pedon_pack() with its own hz_table / ped_table.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

pedon_pack_150 <- build_pedon_pack(
  hz_table     = ncss_hz_table,
  ped_table    = ncss_ped_table,
  max_depth_cm = 150,
  source_name  = "NCSS"
)

glimpse(pedon_pack_150)

# Save outputs
write.csv(ncss_hz_table,
          paste0("../outputs/ncss_hz_table_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(ncss_ped_table,
          paste0("../outputs/ncss_ped_table_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(pedon_pack_150,
          paste0("../outputs/pedon_pack_150_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#figure of distances between all NCSS pedons:
library(geosphere)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
# Filter to pedons with valid coordinates
ncss_geo <- pedon_pack_150 %>%
  filter(!is.na(POINT_X), !is.na(POINT_Y),
         is.finite(POINT_X), is.finite(POINT_Y)) %>%
  select(peiid, POINT_X, POINT_Y)

cat("Pedons with coordinates:", nrow(ncss_geo), "\n")

# Pairwise distances in km using great-circle (Haversine) distance
# distm() returns a matrix of distances in meters
coords_mat <- as.matrix(ncss_geo %>% select(POINT_X, POINT_Y))
dist_mat_m <- distm(coords_mat, fun = distHaversine)
dist_km <- dist_mat_m[upper.tri(dist_mat_m)] / 1000

cat("Number of pairwise distances:", length(dist_km), "\n")
cat("Min:",   round(min(dist_km), 1),    "km\n")
cat("Median:", round(median(dist_km), 1), "km\n")
cat("Mean:",  round(mean(dist_km), 1),   "km\n")
cat("Max:",   round(max(dist_km), 1),    "km\n")

# Plot: distribution of pairwise distances
fig_dist <- ggplot(data.frame(dist_km = dist_km), aes(x = dist_km)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#2C7BB6", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(dist_km), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = median(dist_km), y = Inf, vjust = 2,
           hjust = -0.1, color = "red",
           label = paste0("median = ", round(median(dist_km)), " km")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "Pairwise great-circle distance (km)",
       y = "Number of pedon pairs",
       title = "Geographic spread of NCSS Coastal Plain training pedons",
       subtitle = paste0(nrow(ncss_geo), " pedons; ",
                         format(length(dist_km), big.mark = ","),
                         " pairwise distances")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(fig_dist)
ggsave(here("outputs", "figures_05_02", "ncss_pairwise_distances.png"),
       fig_dist, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```
